note: Values transcribed from /workspace/LTX-2.3/workflows/q4/LTX_2.3_Q4_lowvram_product_ad_api.json and the accepted V6/V8/V14/V15 runs. Node IDs belong to that exact graph; re-verify them if the graph is ever re-exported from the ComfyUI GUI.

models.note: Restored by /workspace/LTX-2.3/scripts/bootstrap-q4.sh against config/q4-models.lock. Peak measured VRAM was about 13.7 GiB, so treat this as a 16 GB configuration despite its '8 GB' publication.

sampling.guide_strength_note: The accepted LumaTalk language runs used 1.0, above the graph's shipped 0.9, to hold identity across a longer clip. Lower it only if the render looks pasted to the reference frame.
sampling.audio_to_video_scale_note: Kept from the accepted runs. The graph always produces an audio stream; pose renders strip it during certification because the delivery contract requires audio_streams=0.

seeds.note: Deterministic seeds make a reroll reproducible and a regression bisectable. A render that has to be rerolled records the attempt number, which shifts the seed by +1000 per attempt.

throughput.measured_reference: The accepted close-up bank was produced on a single RTX 5060 Ti with 15.48 GiB visible VRAM.
throughput.planning_note: Budget per-render wall clock from a real measurement on the target GPU before scheduling a bulk run. record_render_timings() in generate_pose_videos.py writes every observed duration to state/timings.jsonl so the estimate stops being a guess after the first few characters.
throughput.reroll_budget_note: LTX is stochastic. The accepted bank needed rerolls on listening and empathy. Past this budget the pose is escalated for a prompt edit rather than rerolled again.
